title: Recidivism
pdf_title: ## CHAPTER 9 ## RECIDIVISM The information on 'Recidivism' was available in respect of 18,45,090 offenders out of which 17,05,703 i.e. 92.4 percent were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and thrice or more was 5.8 percent, 1.3 percent and 0.5 percent respectively. It was found that 19.3 percent of the persons arrested for the offence of 'Dacoity' were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of 'Recidivism' closely followed by 'Thefts' (15.4), 'Burglary' (15.2 percent) and 'Robbery' (13.2 percent). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of 'Recidivism' are presented in Table 53 and 54.
